claims.subject: Kang 2022 computed pintle temperatures
claims.object: the chemical equilibrium combustion model was applied
claims.statement: Kang et al. (2022) state that the temperature distributions in Figs. 11 and 12 were somewhat over-predicted because the chemical equilibrium combustion model was applied. The Table 4 maximum pintle-tip temperatures (A 1868 K, AI 1468 K, B 1545 K, BI 1398 K) come from the same numerical analysis; the caveat is not restated for Table 4.
qualifiers: applies to CFD results, not measurements
